experiments.cause: raw native direct genomes produced NaN outputs/fitness; strict JSON refused a nonfinite best-fitness metric
experiments.resolution: retain v1 failure cells and partial histories; freeze separate q2-native-v2 invalid-output score/count/all-invalid policy before fresh runs; M1 engine unchanged

experiments.cause: 13,424 discovered connections exceed frozen max_sparse_conns 10,000; both cards independently refused at generation 5
experiments.resolution: failure artifacts retained; q2-capacity-v2 declares 32,768 slots without pruning, frozen but not run

experiments.cause: saturating tanh could conceal infinite FP32 pre-activation
experiments.resolution: mark nonfinite pre-activation invalid; regression fixtures added; 44 tests and fresh numerical/pilot/five-seed acceptance repeated on CPU and each GPU

experiments.cause: untagged local image could not be resolved by repository digest after release tag moved
experiments.resolution: verified the image by its local SHA and retained it as neuroevo:q2-lane; rerun with --pull=never

experiments.cause: upstream EMRConfig dataclass contains multi_hop_chunk_size, but create_config refuses that key
experiments.resolution: retain the internal null setting as metadata and omit it from the parser input; recurrent smoke rerun completed

experiments.cause: results volume was omitted from the Docker invocation
experiments.resolution: copied the partial manifest/dataset to q2-aborted-unmounted, stopped the container, and reran with a persistent mount; no aborted timing result accepted

experiments.cause: planner padded topological order using active node count instead of sequence length
experiments.resolution: pad by actual sequence length; rerun full suite

experiments.cause: Gymnax 0.0.9 imports six without declaring it; pip check alone did not detect this
experiments.resolution: pin six 1.17.0 with wheel hash in compatibility lock; rebuild and rerun

experiments.resolution: Docker Desktop started; host inventory and passthrough successful
